name: Lanseria International Airport

runway.v: Runway 07/25, 2996 m x 45 m, asphalt. (SACAA chart effective 20 Jun 2019; check against the current AIP).

fuel.v: Jet A1 by hydrant on the main apron and by bowser. Between 19:00 and 05:00 refuelling is on the main apron only.
fuel.quote: Jet A1 refuelling by means of Hydrant on main apron and bowsers. Please note between 19:00 and 05:00 refuelling will only be done on the main apron.

hours.v: Tower and approach control 24 hours. Ground movement control 05:45 to 19:00 daily.
hours.quote: Tower and Approach control service: 24 hours; Ground movement control service: [05h45 – 19h00] daily
